title: Experimental and computational physics
purpose: Plan measurements, calibrate instruments, propagate errors and validate simulations against benchmarks.
primary_reading: MIT 12.010 Computational Methods of Scientific Programming

blocks.deliverable: Design a lab notebook and calculate propagated errors.
Use residuals and uncertainty to judge a calibration.
Collect repeated measurements or use supplied data with provenance.
Midcourse code demonstration; perform a step size study.
Validate a random sampling estimator against a known answer.
Vary one assumption and document its effect on the result.
Deliver data, code, limitations and a corrected final report.

project: Deliver one safe physical measurement report and one reproducible numerical benchmark.
completion: finish the final project and practical or oral assessment, repair issues found during review, and retain the full data or code and a short account of remaining limitations.
